name: alpha-pon
description: 長期投資向け調査候補・仮説検証アプリ

scripts.ops:check: pnpm catchup && pnpm daily && pnpm health
scripts.ops:double-check: pnpm catchup && pnpm daily && pnpm health && pnpm catchup && pnpm daily && pnpm health
scripts.test: node --import tsx/esm tests/score.test.ts && node --import tsx/esm tests/validation.test.ts && node --import tsx/esm tests/analysis.test.ts && node --import tsx/esm tests/expert-ensemble.test.ts && node --import tsx/esm tests/stock-decision.test.ts && node --import tsx/esm tests/price-signal.test.ts && node --import tsx/esm tests/safe-wording.test.ts && node --import tsx/esm tests/pro-disagreement.test.ts && node --import tsx/esm tests/pro-generated-data-shape.test.ts && node --import tsx/esm tests/ipo-theme-watch.test.ts
scripts.check: pnpm theme:ipo && pnpm ui:data && pnpm typecheck && pnpm typecheck:tests && pnpm typecheck:scripts && pnpm test
scripts.verify:pro: pnpm pro:all && pnpm theme:ipo && pnpm ui:data && node --import tsx/esm tests/pro-disagreement.test.ts && node --import tsx/esm tests/pro-generated-data-shape.test.ts && node --import tsx/esm tests/ipo-theme-watch.test.ts
scripts.ci:smoke: NOTIFY_MODE=off pnpm daily:mock && pnpm learn:primary && pnpm health:sources && test -f reports/latest.md && test -f reports/primary_disclosure_learning_latest.md && test -f reports/primary_disclosure_category_learning_latest.md && test -f reports/source_health_latest.md
scripts.launchd:install: mkdir -p logs && cp launchd/com.alpha-pon.daily.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ && launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.alpha-pon.daily.plist && echo 'launchd登録完了'
scripts.launchd:uninstall: launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.alpha-pon.daily.plist && rm ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.alpha-pon.daily.plist && echo 'launchd登録解除完了'
scripts.launchd:status: launchctl list | grep alpha-pon || echo '未登録'
scripts.pro:all: pnpm pro:quality && pnpm pro:valuation && pnpm pro:ir-events && pnpm pro:committee
scripts.daily:full: pnpm scan:world && pnpm sync:tdnet:dry && pnpm scan:edinet:annual && pnpm daily:core && pnpm scan:universe && pnpm generate:company-rules && pnpm pro:all && pnpm theme:ipo && pnpm candidate:hypothesis && pnpm review:hypotheses && pnpm memory:companies && pnpm readiness:audit && pnpm ui:data
scripts.check:all: pnpm check && pnpm pro:all && pnpm ui:data && pnpm web:typecheck && pnpm --filter @alpha-pon/web lint && pnpm web:build
scripts.ui:scan:stocks: pnpm scan:universe && pnpm generate:company-rules && pnpm pro:all && pnpm review:hypotheses && pnpm ui:data
